info.title: Price Tracker shared API — proposed
info.description: Proposed source of truth pending team review (#4). Business routes are NOT implemented. Steam base games, US/USD, CheapShark only. See README.md for normative session, ownership, retry, freshness and delivery rules. All objects reject unknown properties. Examples are offline illustrative fixtures, not live quotes.

get.description: Bootstrap a pre-login or current-session-bound CSRF token. Sets the HttpOnly pre-login cookie when needed. Never changes or extends session expiry. Reject Authorization headers; responses are no-store. See README for exact cookie policy.

post.description: Shared registration service. Requires pre-login CSRF cookie/token and exact allowed Origin; never creates a session. Same 202 for existing/new addresses.
Explicit consumption of a single-use fragment token through the shared verification service. No auto-login. Invalid, expired or used token returns TOKEN_INVALID (400).
Generic 202 regardless of address existence/verification. Shared service; pre-login CSRF required.
Generic 202 regardless of address existence. Shared reset-email service; pre-login CSRF required.
Explicit single-use token consumption. Atomically revoke ALL account sessions/device bindings; clear this browser session cookie. No auto-login. TOKEN_INVALID covers used/expired tokens.

Verified accounts only. Requires pre-login cookie/token and exact Origin. Rotate session and CSRF binding. Sets __Host-price_tracker_session for fixed seven days. Response contains NO JWT. Reject bearer headers.

Set-Cookie.description: __Host-price_tracker_session=<opaque>; Path=/; Max-Age=604800; Expires=<matching date>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; no Domain

get.description: Reload bootstrap; returns User directly. Does not slide expiry. Reject bearer headers.

post.description: Revoke current session and bound devices, clear session/pre-login cookies and CSRF binding. No body; no bearer headers. Expired/revoked session returns 401, client still clears local account state.

204.description: Current session revoked; cookies expired with identical name/path/security attributes

post.description: Same registration service as web; generic 202, no session. Reject web cookies. Verification completes intentionally in browser.
Same token service as web, reserved for native integrations; MVP Flutter directs users to browser web completion. No auto-login. Reject web cookies.
Same service and generic response as web. Reject web cookies.
Same service and generic response as web. Reset completes in browser; reject web cookies.
Same single-use token service as web. Revoke all account sessions/device bindings, no auto-login. MVP Flutter uses browser completion. Reject web cookies.
Verified accounts only. Server-revocable JWT, fixed seven-day expiry, no refresh token. Reject web cookies. Store token only in platform-backed secure storage.

get.description: Returns User directly; does not extend expiry. Reject web cookies.

post.description: No body. Revoke current native session and all its device bindings before responding. Reject web cookies. Client also deletes token locally on 401.

Authenticated bounded/cache-aware URL lookup, NOT check-now. Parse allowlisted Steam URLs locally; never fetch submitted URL. Exact validated base-game catalog only. Preview owned by user, expires after 10 minutes; no tracker/history/alert writes. Missing offer is 422, never other-store fallback.

get.description: Owned items only. q is a trimmed case-insensitive literal title substring, never regex/provider search. Sort createdAt descending then id descending. Cursor binds owner, filter and sort; insertions do not duplicate records across pages.

post.description: Create from user's unexpired preview, atomically enforce unique owner/product. UUID Idempotency-Key required. Replay same key/body returns original 201 for 24 hours, before checking preview expiry. Different body/key conflict is 409. Existing product under another key is DUPLICATE_TRACKED_ITEM with owned resourceId. Preview is not consumed; no provider fetch here.

get.description: 404 for absent or foreign item; never disclose other users' targets/preferences.

patch.description: Only targetPrice/enabled/alerts. At least one field. Supplied alerts replaces BOTH booleans. Omitted values unchanged. Replaying identical values cannot rearm an episode. Target changes are not price observations; see alert rules. Concurrent edits are last accepted write wins.

delete.description: No body. Stop future alerts/cancel unsent deliveries; preserve shared product/history and other users' trackers. 404 on already-deleted/foreign item. Already accepted external deliveries cannot be recalled.

get.description: Authorize owned tracker BEFORE shared observations. Successful local observations only, sorted observedAt ascending then id ascending. from inclusive, to exclusive; defaults last 30 days ending now, max window 90 days. retainedFrom is earliest retained time boundary, not a promised first observation. Capture window on page one and repeat it with cursor. No general product-history route.

200.description: Authorized observation page, including empty series

post.description: Android only; derive owner and session from bearer. Bind installation and token atomically to current session, revoke previous binding for same token/installation on account switch. Repeated same registration returns same device id and 201. No raw token in response/logs. Reject web cookies.

put.description: Replace token for owned current-session device after FCM rotation/permission change. installationId must match existing device (409 otherwise). Repeating same body is idempotent. Foreign user/session yields 404. Reject web cookies.

delete.description: No body. Remove owned current-session binding, not another session's device. 404 if absent/foreign; locally treat as already removed. Reject web cookies.

post.description: Admin role required (403 for ordinary user). Enqueue same bounded service as daily scheduler, never inline arbitrary retailer requests. Empty object only. Coalesce overlapping active manual/scheduled run and return its status with 202. Does not bypass caches/provider backoff.

get.description: Admin role required. Poll no faster than Retry-After (minimum 5 seconds). Aggregate status only, no users/tokens/provider payload dumps. Terminal states succeeded/partial/failed; no success claim from mere enqueue.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before another poll while active

webSession.name: __Host-price_tracker_session
webSession.description: Opaque server-revocable session; Secure HttpOnly host-only SameSite=Lax Path=/, fixed seven days. No Domain. See loopback-only development exception in README.

webCsrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
webCsrf.description: Token from GET /api/auth/web/csrf, bound to HttpOnly pre-login cookie or current web session. Exact allowed Origin also required. No bearer/cookie mixing.

mobileBearer.description: Native-only JWT checked against revocable session on EVERY request. No cookies. Fixed seven-day expiry, no refresh tokens.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Decimal integer, one occurrence only; default 20, maximum 100.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque signed continuation, owner/filter/window bound. Never construct or decode. Invalid/tampered/mismatched cursor: 422 INVALID_CURSOR.

BrowserOrigin.name: Origin
BrowserOrigin.description: REQUIRED for web cookie mutations; exact allowlisted origin (scheme/host/port), no wildcard/null. Not required for native bearer requests. This conditional requirement is normative; OpenAPI cannot express header requirements by auth alternative.

RequiredOrigin.name: Origin
RequiredOrigin.description: Exact allowlisted browser origin; reject absent/null/unapproved with 403 ORIGIN_DENIED.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID. Scope user + method + route, retain successful response for 24 hours. Retry identical request/key after uncertain network outcome; never silently use a new key.

Accepted.description: Generic account-email acceptance; never reveals account existence or tokens

User.description: Verified current user; no session extension

BadRequest.description: 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST, TOKEN_INVALID or AUTH_AMBIGUOUS. No token details. Mixed cookie/bearer or wrong auth namespace rejected before processing.

Unauthorized.description: 401 AUTH_REQUIRED, INVALID_CREDENTIALS, SESSION_EXPIRED or SESSION_REVOKED. Invalid credentials use one generic message; clear client state on session loss.

Forbidden.description: 403 EMAIL_UNVERIFIED (only after correct credentials), CSRF_INVALID, ORIGIN_DENIED or ADMIN_REQUIRED.

NotFound.description: 404 NOT_FOUND for absent OR foreign owned resource; resourceId null.

Gone.description: 410 PREVIEW_EXPIRED for owned expired preview; preview again, never silently save changed metadata.

Validation.description: 422 VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_CURSOR, UNSUPPORTED_URL, UNSUPPORTED_PRODUCT, AMBIGUOUS_PRODUCT or STEAM_OFFER_UNAVAILABLE. fields uses JSON pointers for body fields and /query/<name> or /headers/<name> otherwise.

RateLimited.description: 429 RATE_LIMITED or PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED. Required Retry-After delta seconds matches error.retryAfterSeconds. Wait at least that long, bounded retries with jitter; share upstream budget across previews/worker.

Unavailable.description: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE or PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE. No fabricated zero/success; optional Retry-After matches retryAfterSeconds when present.

Id.description: Opaque application identifier; 24-hex is permitted, never inferred to be provider/Steam/deal id.

Timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC (Z), with optional fractional seconds.

attribution.const: Prices supplied by CheapShark; Steam US/USD base-game offer, excluding taxes and checkout adjustments.

url.description: HTTPS store.steampowered.com only; /app/<positive digits> with optional slash/title slug; no credentials, non-default port, query, fragment or other path types. Schema checks URI shape, server must parse and apply allowlist.

Password.description: Do not trim/normalize passwords; reject beyond 128 Unicode code points. No composition rules.

SecretToken.description: Opaque base64url secret; never log/echo. At least 256 random bits for verification/reset and CSRF tokens.

message.const: If eligible, you will receive an email with next steps.

installationId.description: Random installation id generated locally; not a hardware identifier or authorization secret.

PushEvent.description: FCM data payload, ALL values strings. No URLs/secrets/targets; fetch owned tracker after validating session. eventId stable per alert episode across channels/retries; deliveryId stable per push delivery, not per attempt. Session-specific recipient prevents account-switch leakage. Not an HTTP endpoint.
